issue_context.title: endpoint not update even if pod had deleted when node shutdown
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

1. shutdown node host, the kubelet on node enabled GracefulNodeShutdown feature
2. endpoint which associated with pod running on this node, **the endpoint is  not remove after long time**



### What did you expect to happen?

expect the endpoint was removed finally.

when enable nodeGraceFullShutDown, the update logic about node.status.conditions.Ready is below:

```
+--------+         (sync)       +---------+         (async)        +---------+
|  True  +--------------------->|  false  +----------------------->| unknown |
+--------+   kubelet shutdown   +---------+   controller timeout   +---------+
```

when disable nodeGraceFullShutDown and do `(bash)# shutdown now`, the update logic about node.status.conditions.Ready is below:

```
+--------+         (async)        +---------+
|  True   +----------------------->| unknown |
+--------+    controller timeout   +---------+
```

in these situations, just handler when `current condition is unkown` and `cache condition is ready` can cover all

the `monitorNodeHealth` in  node_lifecycle_controller only handler this situation  `true -> unknown`.
when this happend, should do `MarkPodsNotReady` in line https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8aaea8e24c1b87dbd606801f3c3f1e51ee4da44e/pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/node_lifecycle_controller.go#L839

```
	case currentReadyCondition.Status != v1.ConditionTrue && observedReadyCondition.Status == v1.ConditionTrue:
		// Report node event only once when status changed.
		nodeutil.RecordNodeStatusChange(nc.recorder, node, "NodeNotReady")
		fallthrough
```



### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: nginx-test
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx-test
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx-test
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: nginx:1.21
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        name: nginx-test
      priorityClassName: system-cluster-critical
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx-test
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 80
  selector:
    app: nginx-test
  type: ClusterIP
```

1 create resource daemonset and service
2 reboot or shutdown node which enable gracefuleShutDown, could check by `systemd-inhibit --list`
3 `kubectl get ep nginx-test -w` 
4 the endpoint not update eventually

We are seeing this using GKE's 1.22.9-2000 and preemptible nodes. Termianted pods (phase Failed), from a preempted node have container status that indicate they are "ready", and still get listed in endpoints (note that they are listed as *ready* endpoints in addresses, not as notReadyAddresses
